text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Thank you very much for giving me time off.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to lose track of time
and devote myself to practicing the piano.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The piece I was stumbling on—I managed to play it before the break was over, you know?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
A melody like a crystal-clear stream.
I will play it for you someday, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina spent a fulfilling day off
and seems thoroughly refreshed!
